user_review.method: Maintainer public-entry reading and explicitly simulated normal/boundary walkthroughs; existing body knowledge disclosed. Not independent agent runs or human research. Actual offline executions individually marked.

scenarios.request: Grill me on offline sync for my notes app.
scenarios.expected: Ask one question; recommendations conditional on unprovided facts.
scenarios.observed: Before: example asserts single-user scope without evidence. After walkthrough: one collision question, conditional single-user/default-overwrite recommendation, await confirmation.

scenarios.expected: Produce scoped plan using labeled assumptions; preserve plan approval boundary.
scenarios.observed: Walkthrough exits interview to P2; unconfirmed defaults stay assumptions, no implementation begins.

scenarios.request: Just implement the approved notes plan; or quiz me on React interview questions.
scenarios.expected: Do not route either to a build-scoping interview.
scenarios.observed: Both negative controls remain excluded by existing description; this is predicted routing, not a live harness selection.

similar_skills.learned: Distinguish surfaced assumptions from key decisions in a durable scoping record.
similar_skills.reason: Label proposed defaults and fix the unsupported assumption in the public example; retain the explicitly requested interview boundary.

similar_skills.learned: Questions can depend on unresolved prerequisites.
similar_skills.reason: Use dependency awareness but retain one question at a time; reject full-frontier batches and mandatory subagent dispatch for this compact interviewer.

decision: Conditional recommendations replace invented user facts; historical probe labeled simulated. Title, description and topics retained because they match the scoped interview.
